captions.detailed: A camera-mounted hot-shoe flash unit with a dark matte finish. It features a rectangular mounting foot at the bottom, a main vertical body, a swiveling intermediate neck, and a boxy flash head housing a light-grey rectangular diffuser lens. The rear of the main body is equipped with a dark rectangular screen and five small, square control buttons. The neck swivels horizontally on a vertical revolute joint relative to the body, while the flash head tilts vertically on a horizontal revolute joint relative to the neck.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an articulated camera hot-shoe flash. The assembly should feature a base mounting foot, a main body with an integrated rear control screen and five push buttons, an intermediate neck that swivels horizontally, and a boxy flash head with a light-grey diffuser plate that tilts vertically.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a box primitive with chamfered edges, adding a recessed rear face, a small LCD screen, and five individual small box primitives representing the buttons. Build the mounting foot at the bottom using a thin box. Construct the intermediate neck using a box and a cylinder to serve as the vertical swivel interface. Create the flash head as a separate box with a hollowed front recess containing a light-grey diffuser panel. Set up a vertical revolute joint between the main body and the neck, and a horizontal revolute joint between the neck and the flash head.
